adjudication.rationale: The diff shows in app-credential.ts lines 57-77 that the code first does a findFirst to check if a credential exists, then either updates or creates based on that result. This is a classic TOCTOU (time-of-check-time-of-use) race condition. If two concurrent webhook requests arrive for the same userId/appId combination, both could pass the findFirst check (finding no existing credential), and both would then execute the create path, resulting in duplicate credentials. The finding correctly identifies this as a non-atomic operation that could lead to duplicate records.
